data.name: Kassiana
data.gender_notes: Kassiana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kassos' meaning 'boiler, cauldron' or 'tribe', Kassiana is a name of Greek origin meaning 'fine, noble'. In Christian tradition, it is the name of several saints including a 4th-century martyr and a 13th-century nun. The name Kassiana carries the meaning “Fine, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kassiana usually hope their child will grow to embody fine, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kassiana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fine, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kassiana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קאסיאנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קאסיאנה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה היוונית ונמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'קסיה', שפירושה 'צדיק' או 'ישיר', ומוסיף את הסיומת הנשית '-אנה', שפירושה 'אלוהים הוא הצדיק והישיר'. השם קאסיאנה משמש כזכרון לטובת האלוהים והצדק האלוהי.

in_greek.name: Κασσιανή
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Κασσιανή είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και χρησιμοποιείται στην χριστιανική παράδοση. Είναι παράγωγο της λέξης 'Κασία', που σημαίνει 'καλό' και 'δίκαιος', και προσθέτει το θηλυκό επίθετο '-η', που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το όνομα Κασσιανή εκφράζει την καλοσύνη και τη δικαιοσύνη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Cassiana
in_latin.long_meaning: Cassiana is a name derived from the Greek language, used in Christian tradition. It originates from 'Kassia', meaning 'good' and 'righteous', and adds the feminine suffix '-ana', signifying 'God is righteous and good'. The name Cassiana represents the goodness and righteousness of God.

Historically, it has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing faith and devotion. Personality traits associated with Kassiana include kindness, compassion, and a strong sense of morality.
